preconditions.description: The number of shamans N is between 2 and 100000.
The maximum number of trusted friends a shaman can have at any given point D is between 1 and 500.
The number of days U is between 0 and 200000.
The number of questions Q is between 1 and 50000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= H_i <= 10**9 for H_i in H)
preconditions.description: Each altitude H_i is between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A_i < N and 0 <= B_i < N and A_i != B_i for A_i, B_i in U_list)
preconditions.description: Each pair (A_i, B_i) represents a valid pair of distinct shamans.

preconditions.expression: all(x != y and 0 <= x < N and 0 <= y < N and 0 <= v <= U for x, y, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (x, y, v) specifies valid distinct shamans x and y, and a valid day v.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(abs(H[x_prime] - H[y_prime]) for x_prime in trusted[x][v] for y_prime in trusted[y][v]) if trusted[x][v] and trusted[y][v] else 10**9
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum distance between the apartments of some trusted friend x' of x and some trusted friend y' of y on day v, or 10^9 if either x or y had no trusted friends on day v.
